brief:
The Palestinian Ministry of Education and Higher Education set Thursday at 3 p.m. as the release time for second-sitting results from the 2026 general secondary examinations, Shehab Wire reported. The announcement covers students across the West Bank, Gaza Strip, and Palestinian communities abroad.

The ministry did not specify additional details about result distribution methods or student access procedures in the statement.
